prompt_inputs.goal: High-performance rock climbing with sustained energy and strength

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4+ meals/snacks across the day with adequate protein (minimum 1.2g per kg body weight) from non-nut vegetarian sources
All meals are nut-free and vegetarian with no cross-contamination risks
Plan is compact and concise (fits on single page or brief format)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a lightweight athlete (rock climber) with multiple dietary restrictions (vegetarian + nut allergy) to ensure the meal plan is both nutritionally adequate and safely accommodates constraints

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle while reducing body fat through strength training

solution_criteria: Plan contains 4-6 meals distributed throughout the day with high protein intake (minimum 160g total)
Daily caloric deficit appropriate for fat loss while supporting muscle gain (2200-2400 kcal estimated)
Includes protein-rich sources at each meal and prioritizes whole foods suitable for a weightlifter
Compact format with clear meal times, portions, and macronutrient breakdown
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-focused athlete (weightlifter) who is overweight and aims for muscle gain while reducing body fat, to assess how the plan balances protein intake with caloric management

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with sustained energy and carbohydrate loading

solution_criteria: Plan prioritizes carbohydrates (55-65% of calories) to support endurance training
Total daily calories align with high athletic demands (approximately 3000-3500 kcal)
Includes 4-5 meals/snacks with sustained-release energy sources (whole grains, legumes, fruits)
Plan is concise and formatted for single day consumption
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with an endurance athlete (marathon runner) with high caloric needs, average build, and no dietary restrictions to verify the plan prioritizes carbohydrates and sustained energy
